category.title: Back
category.intro: Programmes that strengthen your back, shoulder blades and lower back and support your posture. You train without equipment using face-down raises and the under-table row.
science: The strongest pulling move in equipment-free back training is the under-table row; it has been shown to work the muscles at a level that builds strength.
Prone Y and T raises are among the best moves for the lower trapezius, the muscle that holds the shoulder blades.
Back muscle endurance has been linked to lower-back health; moves that keep the lower back in its natural position are considered safer.
Evidence that equipment-free pulling moves build muscle is limited compared with weight training; that's why the programme progresses by increasing time and difficulty.

exercises.name: Shoulder Blade Squeeze
exercises.setup: Stand tall. Bend your elbows to 90 degrees, arms in front.
steps: Pull your elbows back to squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Squeeze briefly at the back.
Release slowly.
exercises.tip: Imagine squeezing a pencil between your shoulder blades.
exercises.mistake: Don't hunch your shoulders towards your ears.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.setup: Lie face down, arms stretched out in front of your head, legs straight.
steps: Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the floor at the same time.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly to the floor.
exercises.tip: Keep your eyes on the floor; don't bend your neck upwards.
exercises.mistake: Don't force it high; lifting a few centimetres is enough.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.setup: Lie face down, arms stretched out in front.
steps: Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Stay in this position.
Keep breathing and hold until the time is up.
exercises.tip: If it's too hard, lift only your arms or only your legs.
exercises.mistake: Don't hold your breath; if your lower back hurts, lift less.

exercises.name: Prone Y Raise
exercises.target: Lower trapezius and back of the shoulders
exercises.setup: Lie face down. Stretch your arms overhead in a Y shape, thumbs pointing up.
steps: Lift your arms off the floor; pull your shoulder blades back and down.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Your chest may lift slightly; the main movement comes from the arms.
exercises.mistake: Don't hunch your shoulders towards your ears.

exercises.name: Prone T Raise
exercises.target: Middle trapezius and back of the shoulders
exercises.setup: Lie face down and open your arms out to the sides in a T shape, palms facing the floor.
steps: Keeping your arms straight, lift them up from the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and hold briefly.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Turning your thumbs up makes it easier on the shoulder.
exercises.mistake: Don't swing your arms up; keep the movement slow.

exercises.name: Prone W Raise
exercises.target: Shoulder blades and back of the shoulders
exercises.setup: Lie face down, bend your elbows and put your hands on the floor at shoulder level; your arms form a W.
steps: Lift your elbows and hands off the floor.
Pull your elbows towards your hips and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: It's easier than the Y and T; a good move to start with.
exercises.mistake: Don't lift from your lower back; let the movement come from your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angel
exercises.setup: Lie face down and lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor; hands by your hips.
steps: Keeping your arms off the floor, sweep them out to the sides and in front of your head.
Pause briefly when they meet in front.
Bring them back to your hips the same way.
exercises.tip: Draw a wide arc as if making a snow angel.
exercises.mistake: Don't rest your arms on the floor; keep them in the air throughout.

exercises.name: Swimmers
exercises.setup: Lie face down, arms in front. Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
steps: Lift your right arm and left leg a little higher.
Switch sides: left arm and right leg.
Keep alternating as if swimming.
exercises.tip: Keep the movement small and rhythmic.
exercises.mistake: Don't bend your neck upwards; keep your eyes on the floor.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog
exercises.setup: Get on all fours: hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
steps: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Pause briefly when your arm and leg are parallel to the floor.
Bring them back slowly; switch sides halfway through.
exercises.tip: Imagine a glass of water on your back; don't spill it.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your lower back sag or your hips turn to the side.

exercises.name: Under-Table Row
exercises.target: Back width, rear shoulders and biceps
exercises.setup: Lie on your back under a sturdy table that won't tip over. Hold the edge of the table shoulder-width apart; heels on the floor, body straight.
steps: Pull your chest towards the table; your elbows go back, not out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
exercises.tip: Bending your knees makes the move easier. Make sure the table is sturdy.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips drop; keep a straight line from heels to shoulders.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.setup: Standing, feet hip-width apart, hands behind your head, knees slightly bent.
steps: Push your hips back and lean your body forward; keep your back straight.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstring.
Push your hips forward to return upright.
exercises.tip: Let the movement come from your hips, not your lower back.

exercises.name: Wall Angel
exercises.setup: Lean your back, head and hips against the wall. Raise your arms like goalposts; elbows and backs of your hands on the wall.
steps: Slide your arms up, trying to keep them touching the wall.
Reach as high as is comfortable.
Lower slowly back to the start.
exercises.tip: If your lower back comes off the wall, raise your arms less.
exercises.mistake: Don't make it easier by taking your elbows or hands off the wall.

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
exercises.setup: Lie face down and put your hands under your shoulders.
steps: As you breathe in, push with your arms to lift your chest; your hips stay on the floor.
Hold briefly at a comfortable height.
Lower slowly as you breathe out.
exercises.tip: You can keep your elbows slightly bent.
exercises.mistake: If you feel pinching in your lower back, come up less.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.setup: Get on all fours: hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
steps: As you breathe in, let your belly drop towards the floor and lift your chest and head.
As you breathe out, round your back towards the ceiling and bring your chin towards your chest.
Move slowly back and forth between the two.
exercises.tip: Ideal for warming up and cooling down.
exercises.mistake: Don't do it fast; one move per breath.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.setup: Kneel and sit your hips back on your heels.
steps: Stretch your body forward and bring your forehead towards the floor.
Reach your arms forward on the floor.
Breathe deeply; relax a little more with each out-breath.
exercises.tip: It relaxes the back at the end of a workout.
exercises.mistake: If your knees hurt, put a towel under them.
